meta.title: Pricing — Syncologic
meta.description: Pricing hypotheses for Syncologic. Help us shape the plans before launch — Free, Pro, Business, and Private Runner.

hero.headline: Choose the transfer mode that matches your volume, schedule, and trust needs.
hero.subheading: We're still shaping pricing. These are working hypotheses, not commitments — join the waitlist and tell us which one fits you.

hypotheses.title: Four plans we're testing
hypotheses.subtitle: Each plan has a hypothesis we want to validate. Tell us which one matches what you'd actually pay for.

free.name: Free
features: Browser Runner only — tab stays open
One source + destination at a time
Up to a few GB per transfer
free.footnote: What we're testing: whether the Browser Runner alone is useful enough to be a real entry point.

pro.name: Pro
pro.footnote: What we're testing: whether individuals will pay for hosted convenience over manual browser transfers.

business.name: Business
features: Higher data volumes and parallel jobs
business.footnote: What we're testing: whether teams migrating workspaces value the preview, reports, and Cloud Runner enough to pay this tier.

privateRunner.name: Private Runner
features: Run transfers on your own server, NAS, or VPS
Pay for the control plane, not for bandwidth
privateRunner.footnote: What we're testing: whether privacy-minded users will pay a flat fee when they bring their own runner.

affects.title: What affects cost
affects.subtitle: Three factors shape what your plan should look like.

volume.title: Data volume
volume.body: How much data moves per job and per month — the biggest single driver of bandwidth and storage cost.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.body: One-time migrations cost differently than recurring backups. Continuous sync sits in its own bucket.

runner.title: Runner choice
runner.body: Cloud Runner uses our bandwidth. Browser and Private Runner don't — so they cost less to operate.

cloudVsPrivate.title: Cloud Runner vs Private Runner economics
cloudVsPrivate.subtitle: Same control plane, different data path. Pick what fits your trust and volume.

rows.private: Control plane only — flat per-month fee.

rows.cloud: Convenience, scheduled jobs, migrations you don't want to babysit.
rows.private: Privacy, homelabs, businesses, high-volume users on their own bandwidth.

earlyAccess.headline: Join now and shape the plans.
earlyAccess.body: We're not charging anyone yet. Waitlist members get early access and a direct say in which hypotheses become real plans.

items.q: Is there really no firm price yet?
items.a: Yes — these numbers are hypotheses we're testing. The waitlist is how we learn which ones map to real demand before we commit.

items.q: Will the Private Runner cost more than the Cloud Runner?
items.a: Probably less, because you bring the bandwidth. We expect a flat control-plane fee rather than per-GB pricing.
We plan a path toward source-visible, self-hostable infrastructure. Pricing for that path will be set when the model itself is set — see the self-hosted page for details.

items.q: Will I be charged automatically when launch happens?
items.a: No. Joining the waitlist never bills you. Anyone moving from waitlist to a paid plan does so explicitly.

items.q: What happens if my use case spans two plans?
items.a: Tell us in the waitlist questions — that signal is exactly what we use to redraw plan boundaries before launch.

preview.title: See what will happen first
preview.desc: Before anything moves, we show you which files will be copied, replaced, or left alone — so there are no surprises.

scoped.title: We only ask for what we need
scoped.desc: When you connect Google Drive or another cloud, we ask for the smallest permission to do the job — nothing more.

progress.title: Watch it work in real time
progress.desc: See how many files have moved, how much is left, and roughly how long until it's done.

reports.title: A clear summary at the end
reports.desc: Every transfer ends with a simple report you can save or share, so you know exactly what happened.

transparency.title: You choose where your files go
transparency.desc: Run the transfer through us, in your browser, or on your own computer. Your call, every time.
